description: This PHP source file defines a controller class Opencart.Admin.Controller.User.UserPermission for managing user permissions within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, editing, and saving user group permissions, as well as handling navigation breadcrumbs and external extension permissions.

classes.name: UserPermission
classes.description: Controller class for managing user group permissions in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that displays the user permission management page with breadcrumbs, permissions, and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list user groups, returning the list view with pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of user groups, including sorting, ordering, and pagination logic.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a user group, populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of user group permission data submitted from the form.
